product_scope: itpay is the single public Buyer CLI entry point, and $itpay is its user-facing Skill invocation. It covers services, railway planning and booking, orders, authorized purchased content and refunds.
title: Explicit Multi-Service Cart
purpose: Only for a human explicitly combining independent services in one Cart.
current_flow: Use returned catalog item/variant/offer references for cart add; quantities reflect the human request.
Read itpay cart next --json and follow its current line-specific template. Service-backed lines follow their service; do not send them to ordinary buy.
For a returned ordinary Cart buy action, prepare its official page and follow the Skill handoff and consent rules.
Read the same Cart/Checkout after interruption. Ordinary single-service purchases use services purchase; Cart is not a recovery fallback.
